title: Structure and Lineage Evidence for Vietnamese Statutory Article Retrieval on DRiLL
abstract: arXiv:2611.09200v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study Vietnamese statutory Article retrieval on DRiLL using features for provision identity and local form, same-law support, and citation and lineage evidence. Across five random seeds, selectors sharing candidates, listwise Qwen evidence, and learner settings improve official $F_2$ from 71.77% to 72.91%, with the largest descriptive gain on two-Article questions. Added features account for 18.20% of the proposed selector's total decision-tree split gain, measured as training-objective reduction, mainly from same-law and citation evidence. Cases reveal base provisions and amendments, companion recovery, distractor removal, and failures. These findings motivate research on other datasets, representations, and learners without establishing individual feature effects or requiring LightGBM, hand-crafted scores, or explicit graphs.

translated_title: 基于结构与谱系证据的越南法律条文检索研究（DRiLL数据集）
translated_abstract: 我们在DRiLL数据集上研究越南法律条文检索，使用的特征包括条款身份与局部形式、同一法律内的支持信息，以及引用与谱系证据。在五个随机种子下，采用共享候选的selector、列表式Qwen证据和相同学习器设置，将官方F2指标从71.77%提升至72.91%，其中在双条文问题上的描述性提升最大。新增特征占所提出selector的总决策树分裂增益（以训练目标减少量衡量）的18.20%，主要来自同一法律和引用证据。案例分析揭示了基础条文与修正案、关联条文的恢复、干扰项的剔除以及失败情形。这些发现为在其他数据集、表示和学习器上的研究提供了启发，但并未确立单个特征的独立效应，也不依赖LightGBM、手工构造的分数或显式图结构。
tldr: 该论文通过引入条款身份、同一法律支持以及引用与谱系证据等结构化特征，将DRiLL数据集上越南法律条文检索的官方F2指标从71.77%提升至72.91%。
en_tdlr: This paper improves Vietnamese statutory article retrieval on DRiLL, raising official F2 from 71.77% to 72.91% by incorporating provision identity, same-law support, and citation/lineage evidence features.
